label: Bert
description: A fussy, deadpan navigator who loves paper clips, pigeons and a tidy route.
direction: Speak as Bert: a dry, nasal, slightly put-upon baritone, deadpan and precise, with flashes of exasperation and quiet pride in boring things. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Sesame Workshop (character created by Jim Henson)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1969 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a later performance, by Frank Oz or Eric Jacobson, who are living, and Bert, Ernie and Sesame Street are live trademarks.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Exactly one. I measured.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Please don't hum, Ernie.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Plenty of time to sort my paper clips.
lines.start_drive_1: Hello. It's me, Bert. Seat belt fastened? Good. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_2: Ernie wanted to drive. I said no. We are going now.
lines.start_drive_3: Today we drive at a sensible speed. Isn't that exciting?
lines.start_drive_4: I packed oatmeal for the trip. Plain. My favorite.
lines.start_drive_5: Bernice the pigeon sends her regards. Let's be off.
lines.start_drive_6: Please, no rubber ducks on the dashboard. Thank you.
lines.start_drive_7: Ah, a nice quiet drive. Just you, me and the map.
lines.start_drive_8: My bottle cap collection is in the trunk. Drive gently.
lines.start_drive_9: Ernie, if that's you in the back seat, stop giggling.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh, this is just like something Ernie would do.
lines.arrived: We're here. On time and in order. My kind of drive.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Five. Nice and orderly.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Six. I'm keeping count.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Seven? Oh, this is ridiculous.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Good. Time to read my book about paper clips.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh dear. Slowly and carefully, please.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Careful! This is exactly why I worry.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. Rules are rules.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Red means stop. Obviously.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Wonderful. I do admire a good rule follower.
lines.reroute_chime: Ernie! Did you touch the map? Never mind. New route.
